subject: Course-page wording
body:
2026-09-24T12:35:00+02:00 — Nils Braun: Jule, the preview folder has two files labelled CURRENT. I can tidy the link once you identify which one belongs to the review.
2026-09-24T12:35:58+02:00 — Jule Hartmann: I know. Karim is looking at the layout while Dina comments in the copy sheet. They aren't seeing the same headline.
2026-09-24T12:37:05+02:00 — Nils Braun: Could the sheet name the file directly? If I choose by modification time, I may just promote the last person to make a typo.
2026-09-24T12:38:23+02:00 — Jule Hartmann: Put the question at the top. Admissions also needs something plainer than the slogan for phone enquiries.
2026-09-24T12:39:46+02:00 — Nils Braun: Greta asked for three sentences about practice. That sounds more useful than trying to describe a preview screenshot.
2026-09-24T12:40:50+02:00 — Jule Hartmann: Yes. I'll take Dina's examples to the discussion. Please leave both files alone until the review sheet is explicit.
